text:
sara_support: heads up — customer applix reported a regression after yesterday's model rollout. They say outputs are sometimes reverting to the old behavior (pre-rollout) for some prefixes. customer thread: 'we started getting old canned responses for onboarding prompts, even though model shows v2'

joseph_cs: thanks, can you drop an example prompt + response and the customer request id? we need exact repro.

sara_support: here — request id x-req-id: req_0a9f2c, model: redwood-v2, timestamp 2026-03-15T18:22:11Z. Prompt starts with onboarding system prefix `<<ONBOARD_V2>>` then user instructions. Response included legacy phrasing like 'Welcome back to Onboard v1...'.

ryan_eng_oncall: possible KV/prefix cache collision. quick hypothesis: cache key didn't incorporate the model_version header for canary traffic, so cached KV entries from v1 are being reused for v2 requests when prefix hashing truncated. i'll try repro locally.

ryan_eng_oncall: repro steps I used:
1) seed prefix: `<<ONBOARD_V2>> Welcome to product`
2) call with model: redwood-v2 but omit `model_version` header (simulates some SDK older clients)
3) send same prefix but different session token -> server returned cached KV snippet from v1.

ryan_eng_oncall: curl I ran:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "x-prefix-id: onb_345" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"<<ONBOARD_V2>>\nUser: I need help with setup"}'
```
returned the legacy lines.

lina_prod: if that's the case, customers on older SDKs could be silently affected. is there a short-term mitigation? invalidate prefix cache for affected orgs?

ryan_eng_oncall: i pushed a quick hotfix to the runtime to add model_version and model name into the KV cache key (PR #4451). Also added a guard to avoid using cached KV entries if prefix length changed > 32 tokens.

ops_bot: deploy started: canary runtime v1.2.8-hotfix -> 3% traffic (deploy id deploy_20260315_07)

joseph_cs: sara, can you request applix to test again after the canary? i'll coordinate rollback if it doesn't fix.

sara_support: pinged applix — they confirmed within 20m that the onboarding text now matches v2 and no stale lines seen.

ryan_eng_oncall: rolled the hotfix to 100% after canary looked good. invalidated prefix caches for accounts: applix, beta-co, and test-org-7 via admin tool. command used:
```
admin invalidate-prefix-cache --org applix --prefix onb_345
```

lina_prod: logging and monitoring note: added an alert to watch for prefix cache hit rate spikes where model_version header mismatch occurs. also created an RCA ticket to track root cause: missing model_version propagation in older SDKs + a key-hashing truncation edge case.

joseph_cs: closing loop with customer. applix replied :white_check_mark: 'Looks good now, thanks for quick turnaround.'

sara_support: will add a KB article describing the issue and mitigation (KB: prefix-cache-staleness) and flag SDK teams to backfill model_version header.

ryan_eng_oncall: postmortem planned Monday. summary: regression due to KV cache key construction not including model identity and vulnerable to prefix-hash truncation. fix: include model identifiers in the cache key + defensive prefix-length checks + targeted invalidation.

ops_bot: incident resolved and severity downgraded to SEV4.

sara_support: thanks everyone.
